history_policy: This version hash-inherits every V42 workload, representation, width, job count, checksum, execution mode, scored operation, attribution counter, mixed-tier replay signature, timing boundary, occupancy rule, binary-provenance profile, publication ruling, process classification, and diagnostic schema. It changes no scored row or execution hot path. It adds the JSON/JSC pipeline collector to the frozen integration boundary after that collector adopted the shared fail-closed process classifier. Any later workload, boundary, jobs, checksum, metric source, adapter, integration ruling, diagnostic schema, process policy, or publication change needs its own version.
change: Pins the JSON/JSC pipeline collector and its shared process classifier after every native invocation gained before/after competitor snapshots. Collection now fails closed on concurrent builds, tests, command-bearing Bun processes, and macOS ReportCrash work instead of publishing scheduler-contaminated evidence.

json_pipeline_integration.publication_boundary: Every JSON/JSC, tier-residency, and gap-reduction runner invocation is bracketed by the V42 shared fail-closed process classifier. A competing process aborts collection before either raw samples or a rendered report is written; the existing identity, checksum, order, sample-index, and median-floor gates remain unchanged.
